digest.component_or_area: ADR-0083 documentation, reconciler vendor adapter capability detection
propositions: isinstance against @runtime_checkable Protocol on Python 3.12+ uses getattr_static which does not resolve __getattr__ attributes, causing false negatives for dynamically-proxying objects
ADR-0083 prescribed isinstance-only capability detection which is correct on Python 3.11 but silently fails on Python 3.12+, causing writes to be skipped
Tree-wide sweep under Python 3.12.13 confirms all existing capability dispatch sites are already proxy-safe via hasattr fallback or __instancecheck__ override
ADR-0083 amendment required to document isinstance as necessary-but-not-sufficient on Python 3.12+ and prescribe isinstance-primary plus member-level hasattr fallback pattern
